$comment: Run-scoped settings for the UNATTENDED review engine (scripts/harness_autoreview.py), passed via `claude -p --settings`. The run uses --dangerously-skip-permissions, which suppresses permission PROMPTS but not explicit DENY rules. The engine's input is the tail of a FAILING log, which is untrusted (a prompt-injection surface): without these denies an injected instruction could make the agent read ~/.secrets and copy it into the review note. `~/` is your home directory; `./` is the vault (the engine runs with cwd = vault). Edit only deliberately, then re-seal: python scripts/harness_autoreview.py --seal
